subject: microbiology
title: Escherichia coli Pathotypes: EHEC O157:H7, ETEC and Diarrhoeagenic Groups

steps.tx: **Escherichia coli** is gut's model commensal turned pathotype library: gram negative motile bacillus, lactose fermenting pink on MacConkey, indole positive, IMViC plus plus minus minus, billions harmless, defined virulence sets causing diarrhoea (six pathotypes), urinary infection, sepsis and meningitis. Pathotype, not species, is the diagnosis.
steps.say: Same species, six diarrhoea machines plus urinary empire: ask which E coli.

vis.alt: Proteus swarming motility plate illustrating enteric bacteriology
vis.caption: Enteric bacteriology plate work, the MacConkey world E coli pathotypes are sorted in.

steps.tx: **Enterotoxigenic E coli** (ETEC) colonises small bowel (colonisation factor antigens) and secretes heat labile toxin (cholera toxin twin raising cAMP) and heat stable toxin (guanylate cyclase), traveller's and infant watery diarrhoea without invasion or fever much, prevention by water and food discipline, bismuth and vaccine hopes.
steps.say: Attach, secrete, purge water: ETEC is cholera mechanism in miniature.

left.title: ETEC toxins
points: LT: AB5, ADP ribosylates Gs, cAMP secretion
STa: guanylyl cyclase C, cGMP secretion
No invasion, no blood, little fever

steps.tx: **Enterohaemorrhagic E coli** (EHEC, Shiga toxin producing STEC, O157:H7 emblem) attaches effacing in colon and secretes Shiga toxins injuring endothelium: bloody diarrhoea without much fever, haemolytic uraemic syndrome risk, cattle reservoir, ground beef and produce vehicles, antibiotics and antimotility debated harmful (toxin release), sorbitol MacConkey screening misses non O157 strains.
steps.say: Bloody stool, little fever, burger history: culture Shiga toxin, hydrate, hesitate antibiotics.

right.title: EHEC management
points: Shiga toxin immunoassay and PCR all bloody stools
Public health notification and food traceback

steps.tx: Remaining **diarrhoeagenic four**: enteropathogenic EPEC (effacing, infant diarrhoea, bundle pili), enteroaggregative EAEC (stacked brick adherence, persistent diarrhoea and traveller), enteroinvasive EIEC (Shigella twin invasion and dysentery), diffusely adherent DAEC (children). Each adherence pattern is a bench and biopsy portrait. Modern stool panels identify these genes directly, reducing dependence on cell culture adherence assays that once defined the groups.
steps.say: Efface, stack, invade, diffuse: adherence patterns name the remaining four.

left.title: Adherence pathotypes
points: EAEC: aggregative stacked bricks, biofilm mucus

right.title: Invasive pathotype
points: Multiplex PCR panels report pathotypes today

steps.tx: **Extraintestinal E coli** (ExPEC: uropathogenic and meningitis lineages) carries P pili, siderophores, capsule K1 (neonatal meningitis twin of group B streptococcus terrain) and haemolysin, gut reservoir invading urinary tract ascending and blood in neonates and elderly. UTI module in pharmacology rests on this virulence set.
steps.say: The urinary E coli is gut E coli with climbing gear and iron theft tools.

right.title: Meningitis kit
points: S fimbriae and Ibe invasion proteins

steps.tx: **Laboratory pathotype work** today is multiplex PCR on stool (syndromic panels detecting stx, eae, LT ST and invasion genes with culture reflex for outbreaks and susceptibility) because pathotypes share one colony face. Culture independent results need isolate recovery for typing in Shiga toxin cases publicly.
steps.say: Colonies all look alike; genes name the pathotype, culture still feeds outbreak law.

right.title: Culture duties
points: Broth enrichment and immunoassay for non O157
Refer isolates for serotype and genome

steps.tx: **Antibiotic logic in diarrhoeagenic E coli** is pathotype split: traveller ETEC and EAEC may shorten with azithromycin or rifaximin by region, dysentery treated, EHEC avoided, self limits otherwise, ORS universal. One species receives opposite antibiotic orders by toxin, the module's cleanest stewardship parable.
steps.say: Same species: treat traveller, spare Shiga toxin: pathotype writes the prescription.

right.title: Avoid patterns
points: Stool testing before antibiotics where safe

steps.tx: **E coli as indicator organism** (coliform counts in water and food) closes its dual life: faecal indicator by lactose fermentation at 44 degrees (thermotolerant), presence meaning recent faecal contamination and possible pathogens, drinking water zero per 100 millilitres standard. The pathogen is also the pollution meter.
steps.say: Find E coli in water and faeces were there recently; zero per hundred is the drinking rule.

left.title: Indicator logic
points: Faecal coliform and E coli at 44.5
Presence absence tests for treated water

right.title: Indicator limits
points: Viruses and cysts outlast E coli absence
Tropical waters carry environmental E coli
